{{Short description|Argentine botanist (1921–2015)}}
'''Antonio Krapovickas''' (8 October 1921 &ndash; 17 August 2015)<ref>{{cite web| title=Author Attributions | url=http://www.calflora.net/bloomingplants/authorattributions.html | publisher=calflora.net | accessdate=2008-06-19| archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20080621081956/http://www.calflora.net/bloomingplants/authorattributions.html| archivedate= 21 June 2008 | url-status= live}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|title=Reports of the Secretary and Treasurer: John Simon|publisher=John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation|page=96|year=1953}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | url=http://www.scielo.org.ar/scielo.php?script=sci_arttext&pid=S1851-23722015000400016 |title = Ing. Agr. Dr. Antonio Krapovickas 1921 - 2015|journal = Boletín de la Sociedad Argentina de Botánica|volume = 50|issue = 4|pages = 639–640|last1 = Neffa|first1 = Solís|last2 = G|first2 = Viviana}}</ref> was an [[Argentina|Argentine]] [[agronomist]].

Krapovickas received a degree in 1948 in [[Agronomy|agronomic engineering]] from the [[University of Buenos Aires]] and began teaching in 1949 as Professor of [[Genetics]] and Systems Botany at the [[National University of Córdoba|University of Córdoba]]. He later became Professor of Plant [[Anatomy]] at the [[National University of Tucumán]].<ref name="UNNE">{{cite web|url=http://eluniversitario.unne.edu.ar/2005/87/pagina/fbl00.htm |title=Homenaje a dos Docentes en el 85° Aniversario de la Facultad |publisher=Facultad de Ciencias Agrarias de [[National University of the Northeast|UNNE]] |accessdate=2008-06-19 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080413140939/http://eluniversitario.unne.edu.ar/2005/87/pagina/fbl00.htm |archivedate=2008-04-13 |language=es |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In 1964, he moved to [[Corrientes]] to accept a position at the [[National University of the Northeast]] (UNNE), becoming chair of its Department of Botany and Ecology in 1977. He also founded the university's botanical gardens, {{langx|es|[[Instituto de Botánica del Nordeste]]}} or ''Ibone'', with his wife, Dr. [[Carmen L. Cristóbal]].<ref name="BYB">{{cite web|url=http://www.fundacionbyb.org/premio_detalle_agronomia.asp |publisher=Fundación Bunge y Born |title=Investigación Científica |accessdate=2008-06-19 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080827223809/http://www.fundacionbyb.org/premio_detalle_agronomia.asp |archivedate=2008-08-27 }}</ref>

Krapovickas' research centered on [[Taxonomy (biology)|taxonomy]] of the family [[Malvaceae]] and biology of species in the genus ''[[Arachis]]'' ([[Fabaceae]]). His publications in these fields, including over 110 papers, 8 book chapters, and a [[monograph]] on ''Arachis'' - the genus of the groundnut - that he coauthored with [[Walton C. Gregory]], are very influential and widely cited.<ref name="UNNE"/>

==Awards and distinctions==
* [[Guggenheim Fellowship|John Simon Guggenheim Fellow]] (1953)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://jsg.gf.org/kfellow.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010629184920/http://jsg.gf.org/kfellow.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=2001-06-29 |accessdate=2008-06-19 |title=Fellows Whose Last Names Begin With ''K'' |publisher=[[John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation]] }}</ref>
* [[CONICET]] Research Scientist (1961&ndash;1994)
* Director of Ibone (1977&ndash;1991)
* President of the ''Sociedad Argentina de Genética'' (1983&ndash;1985)
* [[Konex Award]] in Science and Technology recipient (1983)<ref>{{cite web| url=http://www.fundacionkonex.com.ar/premios/curriculum.asp?id=124 | publisher=Fundación Konex | title=Premio Konex 1983 | accessdate=2008-06-19|language=es}}</ref>
* ''Centro Argentino de Ingenieros Agrónomos'' (CADIA) Prize recipient (1984)
* Corresponding member of the [[Botanical Society of America]] (1989)
* ''[[Bunge y Born]]'' Award in Agronomy recipient (1990)<ref name="BYB"/>
* [[Professor emeritus]] at UNNE (1990)
